mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term in regression has non-significant positive coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO falling from prior month), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced manufacturing output and recessionary signals.
failure_condition: In months where INDPRO declines from prior month, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO decline as predictor is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units signals strong residential market activity that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 60-day returns is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or correlation between PAYEMS and returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates monetary policy misalignment that triggers market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term in regression has non-significant negative coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 qoq > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion that boosts investor confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In quarters where GDPC1 qoq growth exceeds 2.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC for GDPC1 growth as predictor of 5-day returns is less than 0.03.
